summary.hypothesis: Remaining-budget hypothesis: future-aware value control will improve exact recovery of held-out, multi-step reachable molecular targets relative to myopic control. The horizon clause was tested in the tie-broken-by-index run and not supported (+3/0/+2 at 4/5/6), so it is dropped; horizon is reported as an observation.
summary.override_rule: strict improvement only: the planner overrides greedy only when a candidate has strictly better remaining-budget value; ties keep the greedy action
summary.verdict: LOOKAHEAD AHEAD -- 18 vs 12 exact recoveries; future value has something to buy on reachable targets

per_pair.cost_caveat: Greedy runs first and its enumerations are cached, so the lookahead arm reuses them. Its marginal cost is honest; its standalone cost would be higher. Compare arms on marginal calls, not on a ratio.
